title: HUGIN: Enhancing Vision-Language Planning for Autonomous Logistics Sorting
abstract: arXiv:2608.11692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous logistics sorting systems (ALSS) are an important industrial application of embodied AI, which requires joint planning over spatially disjoint camera views. We formulate this setting as Joint Multi-Scene Understanding (JMSU). With open-world visual understanding and task-planning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for JMSU. However, directly applying existing VLMs to JMSU is non-trivial due to scarce cross-scene supervision and attention dispersion caused by long visual context in JMSU. To address these challenges, we propose HUGIN, a training framework with two complementary components. Endogenous Data Augmentation recombines verified atomic facts under operating constraints, while Global Context Ranking aligns the instruction representation more strongly with the complete visual context than with a partial visual context. translated_title: HUGIN：增强自主物流分拣的视觉-语言规划能力
translated_abstract: 自主物流分拣系统（ALSS）是具身智能的重要工业应用，它需要在空间上分离的多个摄像头视图上进行联合规划。我们将这一场景定义为联合多场景理解（JMSU）。凭借开放世界的视觉理解和任务规划能力，视觉-语言模型（VLMs）是JMSU的有力候选方案。然而，由于JMSU中跨场景监督稀缺以及长视觉上下文导致的注意力分散，直接将现有VLMs应用于JMSU并非易事。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了HUGIN，一个包含两个互补组件的训练框架。内生数据增强在操作约束下重新组合已验证的原子事实，而全局上下文排序则使指令表示与完整视觉上下文的对齐强于与部分视觉上下文的对齐。为支持持续研究，我们构建了一个高质量的工业场景数据集。
tldr: 本文提出HUGIN训练框架，通过内生数据增强和全局上下文排序，解决了自主物流分拣中联合多场景理解面临的长视觉上下文注意力分散和跨场景监督稀缺问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HUGIN, a training framework with endogenous data augmentation and global context ranking, to address attention dispersion and scarce cross-scene supervision in joint multi-scene understanding for autonomous logistics sorting.
